title: NILS pipeline opinions (System 1)
description: Record 55 D3 and record 56 (spec 11.1): the opinions member of a pipeline run's results.json, what System 1 says of each stack and axis: its answer, its calibrated probability, the reliability of the rules on that header (the error model with the signs of damage) and the fields that mattered most, each measured by leaving it out. The engine keeps them beside the rules' answers. An opinion is never a decision and raises no review item by itself: it is shown beside the questions Review holds, and on a dataset flagged as having damaged headers it feeds the gate once System 1 is confirmed by a recorded certificate. Only a model registered for the task system1 and admitted, promoted or chosen may give one, and only on the run's own stacks.

stack_id.description: The stack, by the id the run's stacks.json gave it

axis.description: An axis of the pack, declared in the descriptor's x-nils.opinions

value.description: The answer: a value of the axis, a list of values for a multi-valued axis, or null for no value

reliability.description: How far the rules can be trusted on this header, from the error model and the signs of damage (missing fields, unknown words, an unseen vendor, a fallback clause); null where the model has no reliability part

effect.description: The change in the answer's probability when the field is left out

fields.description: The fields that mattered most, largest effect first

probabilities.description: The probability of each class the head weighed, where it has one

model_id.description: The registered model, by the id the run's model manifest gave it

note.description: Words a person reads beside the numbers. Never a name, a code or a date of a person
